# Security policy

Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities through a public issue, pull request, discussion or screenshot.

Use the repository's private [GitHub Security Advisory form](https://github.com/DasadiaSmit/solar-intelligence-operating-system/security/advisories/new). Include:

- affected surface and version/commit;
- impact and prerequisites;
- minimal reproduction with secrets and personal data removed;
- whether data integrity, authorization, provider credentials, scientific results or deployment are affected;
- any suggested mitigation.

The maintainer will acknowledge a reproducible report, assess severity, prepare a private fix and coordinate disclosure. Exact response timelines are not promised while the project has a single maintainer.

The platform is research and decision-support software. A vulnerability report must not be used to imply that simulated production, financial values or engineering outputs are certified or guaranteed.

See [`docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`](../docs/THREAT_MODEL.md) and [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md) for current trust boundaries, controls and known gaps.
